canonical_data: a local database of recognised text, transcripts, and frame and audio metadata alongside local video and audio files
current_repo_note: Relicensed in June 2026 from a permissive licence to a custom commercial licence covering the whole tree, which permits personal, non-profit, and short evaluation use and requires a paid licence for commercial use; earlier permissive releases remain available under their original terms. Several library manifests still declare an enterprise identifier with no matching licence file, which the library readme says is superseded by the root licence. Release builds check for a paid plan.
strengths: The only ambient-capture system reviewed with an agent-facing API and tool-server endpoint, so what was seen and heard is retrievable by software rather than only by a person
Explicit retention auto-deletion, raw query, and export controls over a database the user holds
Broad continuous integration across three platforms with end-to-end, chaos, and evaluation suites, and near-daily releases
weaknesses: Since June 2026 no part of the tree is under an open licence, and the licence claims ownership of contributors' modifications
Product analytics and crash reporting are on by default in the desktop app despite the claim that everything is local
Release builds are subscription-gated, so the free path is building from a fast-moving multi-toolchain tree
why_it_matters: Shows the ambient-capture category migrating from open hobby projects to a venture-backed source-available product with an agent interface.
